snippet.title: Neon Breaker : Endless Arcade SHMUP Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Manga heart. Synthwave soul. Arcade fury.

Neon Breaker is a challenging horizontal twin-stick shmup 3d retro shooter in the legacy of the great action arcade classics. 

Shoot, evade, and hunt down enemy ships to great synthwave music! 

Push your limits playing through endless waves and unlock new high scores.

Releasing end of October 2026 after Steam Next Fest.

Wishlist available now on Steam with 20% release discount for the first 2 weeks!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5054650/Neon_Breaker/
